title: VU#128947: COVESA vsomeip excessive memory allocation in reliable (TCP) endpoint buffer handling
description: vsomeip, an open source implementation of the SOME/IP automotive communication middleware, contained a memory allocation vulnerability in versions 3.7.3 and below. The vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated peer to cause excessive memory allocation by declaring a large message size on a reliable (TCP) endpoint before the actual message bytes are received. This can lead to denial of service by exhausting host memory. The issue was fixed in version 3.7.4 by introducing a default maximum message size limit of 10 MiB.
